title: Nautilus Omega Optimization Audit
content: Nautilus Omega Optimization Audit Date: 2026-05-18 Optimization principles No optimization without integrity. Prioritize measurable operator-facing or cost-facing impact. Preserve deterministic semantics and explicit degraded truth. Prioritized opportunities P1 (high leverage) Event batching with bounded flush interval for non-critical telemetry. Retrieval deduplication cache by normalized query + policy context. Proofpack incremental generation from immutable lineage fragments. Topology snapshot caching with TTL + invalidation on runtime state change. P2 (medium leverage) Lazy-load heavy operator report sections unless requested. Reduce duplicate JSON serialization across event/report/proofpack pathways. Introduce span compression for long-running replay timelines. Parallelize independent adapter probes with strict concurrency limits. P3 (situational) Dependency surface pruning in CLI/plugin runtime bundles. Background compaction for historical evidence indices. Guardrails Every optimization PR must include before/after measurements. No hidden fallback that masks degraded or unavailable states. No trust-score extrapolation without provenance evidence
summary: Prioritize measurable operator-facing or cost-facing impact.
